draft_en.subject: Active items next to your cable lines - gigabit media converters and 8-PoE switches
draft_en.body:
Hello West Penn Wire team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the media converters and PoE switches you offer alongside your cable lines to security and AV installers, two neutral-brand items from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS:

- Industrial mini Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP, 12-58 V DC, model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity)
- 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based, model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD EXW

One question: which active SKU do your distributors ask for most - the converter or the 8-PoE switch?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
